messages:
mira: Anyone else freezing in the open area? It's like the office turned into the Arctic :cold_face:
sam: yes. I brought socks. also considering bringing a blanket :blanket:
andre: It's 18C on the thermostat but feels colder. Opened a window and forgot to close it earlier 🙈
lia: Can confirm, I can see my breath when I debug at 10am :joy:
ops-bot: HVAC alert: Temperature variance detected in floor 3, zone B. Escalating to facilities@redwood.com
katie: Facilities said they set eco-mode for Tuesday—energy saving trial. They didn't warn us :eyes:
mira: Is eco-mode code for 'let's freeze the engineers into faster code' ? :stuck_out_tongue:
sam: vote: 1) request thermostat override, 2) bring space heaters, 3) staging a unity protest with hot cocoa.
andre: I vote hot cocoa. I will bring marshmallows.
lia: I can bring a kettle. who has the mugs? :coffee:
katie: there's a communal mug rack but last time someone labeled them with cryptic stickers 'do not steal' :sweat_smile:
mira: @katie can you poke facilities? also +1 on cocoa
ops-bot: Reaction added :thumbsup: from ops-bot
sam: Also office policy reminder: no personal space heaters without approval, unless it's 'marshmallow heater' which is obviously allowed.
andre: lol
lia: ok I'll ping facilities now. in the meantime, desk blanket raid at 2pm
mira: love it. meeting invite incoming called 'Blanket Raid' :calendar:
sam: bring snacks and possibly a thermal potato.
katie: thermal potato? new team snack standard.
andre: imagine the thermal potato becoming an emblem of the devteam
mira: thermal potato emoji incoming :potato:
lia: end of thread: blankets > eco-mode :tada:
